packs.summary: All expected May and quarterly submissions were received except the May dealer list, which was reused rather than freshly provided, and reconciliation identified loans missing from the May tape and a charge-off difference against the servicer report, both now queried with the submitting party. A vehicle securing loans in both Bramble and Northmoor has been confirmed and reported to the lender, and leverage, which would exceed its maximum only if an affiliate guarantee is counted, has been referred for expert review.

sections.heading: Submissions
sections.text: We received the May loan tape, May servicer report, May borrowing base certificate, first-quarter financial statements, first-quarter compliance certificate and the second amendment to the facility agreement. The May dealer list was a reused version rather than a new submission.

sections.heading: Reconciliation
sections.text: The roll-forward expected a pool balance of {{expected}}, against {{actual}} on the May tape, a gap of {{gap}}. The roll-forward identified {{missing}} loans missing from the May tape, and a query has been raised with the submitting party. Charge-offs in the servicer report exceed those on the tape by {{charge_off_difference}}, with {{charge_off_loans}} loans shown as charged off in the report but still live on the tape; this has also been queried with the submitting party. A new column on the May tape has no corresponding platform field, and there are minor gaps in fields not used by any test; both were logged as within tolerance and the field gaps will be raised with the next query.

sections.heading: Borrowing base and terms
sections.text: We recomputed the May borrowing base at {{borrowing_base}}, giving availability of {{availability}}. The certificate's borrowing base is {{certificate_difference}} above our recomputed figure, a rounding difference within the agreed certificate tolerance of {{tolerance}}, so no alert was raised. The second amendment raises both the facility limit and the dealer limit from June; these changes were logged and require no action.

sections.heading: Triggers and covenants
sections.text: The rolling delinquency average was {{delinquency_average}}, against a delinquency trigger of {{delinquency_limit}}. The borrower reported leverage of {{leverage_reported}}, against a maximum of {{leverage_limit}}. If the affiliate guarantee of {{guarantee}}, which is kept off the balance sheet, is counted, leverage would be {{leverage_with_guarantee}} and above its maximum. Whether the guarantee should count has been referred for expert review, and the conclusion rests with the reviewer and the lender.

sections.heading: Collateral
sections.text: We confirmed that one vehicle secures a loan in both Bramble and Northmoor, and the lender has been informed; any further action is for the lender to decide. Pool growth in April was faster than usual, and the servicer report explains the reason; this was logged and requires no action.

sections.heading: Open items
sections.text: There are {{open_items}} items requiring action. These are the queries to the submitting party on the loans missing from the May tape and on the charge-off difference, the expert review of whether the affiliate guarantee counts towards leverage, and the vehicle securing loans in both Bramble and Northmoor, which has been reported to the lender.

briefs.opening: For this week's call with Calderwood Bank plc, Priya, the main items are Northmoor's late servicer report and held tape load, Bramble's tape gaps and exclusions, and two Kestrel and Bramble tests awaiting an expert's view.

sections.heading: Missing data
points: Northmoor's May servicer report, due {{northmoor_due}}, has not arrived; we have chased and escalated it.
Bramble did not resend its dealer list; with the client's consent, we reused the April list.
Northmoor's May tape repeats the row for loan {{duplicate_loan}}, so we are holding the load until the servicer confirms it.

sections.heading: Open questions
points: Northmoor: we have sent a reminder and an escalation for the May servicer report.
Bramble: the roll-forward found a gap of {{gap}}, with {{missing_loans}} loans missing from the May tape; we are asking the servicer to explain them.
Bramble: the servicer report shows charge-offs {{charge_off_difference}} higher than the tape, with {{charge_off_loans}} loans charged off in the report but still live on the tape.
Kestrel: one investment's valuation is {{stale_days}} days old, which is older than the agreement allows.
Northmoor: we are asking the servicer to confirm the repeated row for loan {{duplicate_loan}} before we load the tape.

sections.heading: Exclusions
points: Bramble: we excluded {{ineligible_loans}} receivables worth {{ineligible}} as not eligible, and deducted {{concentration_excess}} of dealer concentration excess.
Bramble: the {{missing_loans}} loans missing from the tape stay out of the pool until the servicer explains them.

sections.heading: Identifier changes
points: There were no identifier changes on the client's facilities this month.

sections.heading: Missing financials
points: Nothing is outstanding: Bramble's Q1 statements and compliance certificate arrived before the due date.

sections.heading: Waiting on an expert
points: Bramble: leverage is over its maximum only if the affiliate guarantee counts, giving {{leverage_with_guarantee}}; once the expert's view arrives, the client may need to decide how to treat the guarantee.
Kestrel: loan-to-value is being assessed both with and without the post-quarter markdown, giving {{ltv_with_markdown}} if the markdown counts; the client may need to decide which basis applies.
